Oceanfront Folly Beach Hotel Near Charleston, SC | Tides Folly Beach
pet_sentences: Pet-friendly accommodations (fees apply)
Pet Friendly
Is Tides Folly Beach pet-friendly?
Tides Folly Beach welcomes dogs in designated pet-friendly accommodations, making it easy to enjoy an unforgettable beach vacation with your four-legged family member
Please contact the hotel for current pet fees, availability, and policies
Are dogs allowed on Folly Beach?
Dogs are welcome on Folly Beach year-round, but the City of Folly Beach has seasonal regulations
From May 1 through September 30, dogs are not permitted on the beach between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM
Outside of those hours—and throughout much of the fall and winter—dogs are welcome on the beach while leashed and under their owner’s control
Do dogs have to be on a leash at Folly Beach?
The City of Folly Beach requires dogs to be leashed and under their owner’s control while on the beach
Owners are also responsible for cleaning up after their pets
When is the best time to visit Folly Beach with a dog?
Fall and winter are wonderful times to bring your dog to Folly Beach
It’s one of the best seasons for a pet-friendly coastal getaway
Can I bring my dog to the beach during the summer?
During the summer season (May 1–September 30), dogs are welcome on the beach before 10:00 AM and after 6:00 PM
These cooler hours are often more comfortable for both pets and their owners

pet_sentences: The 80+ guest rooms range from classic and cozy to spacious, gallery-inspired spaces, and we offer dog-friendly accommodations (sorry, felines)
Pet Friendly
Is The Vendue pet-friendly?
The Vendue welcomes dogs for a one-time pet fee per stay
Canine guests receive thoughtful amenities, including food and water bowls, a pet mat, and a gourmet welcome treat
Please note that pets other than dogs are not permitted
Are service animals welcome at The Vendue?
Service animals are always welcome at The Vendue in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
Where can I walk my dog near The Vendue?
Towards the end of Waterfront Park you will find a public dog park, perfect for socializing and play
Charleston’s historic streets and waterfront promenade also make for enjoyable walks with your dog
Is Charleston a dog-friendly destination?

Charleston is one of the country’s most dog-friendly cities, with walkable historic neighborhoods, outdoor dining patios, parks, pet-friendly shops, and nearby beaches that welcome dogs during certain times of the year
Are there dog-friendly restaurants near The Vendue?
Many restaurants near The Vendue offer pet-friendly outdoor seating, allowing you to enjoy Charleston’s dining scene with your dog
